reason: The hypothesis directly restates the conclusion of P1/P10 that dynamic precipitation of M23C6 and Cr-rich phases at phase boundaries increases stress exponent and activation energy by acting as barriers to dislocation climb in an FCC HEA at 500–600°C. The proposed intervention (pre-treating to promote vs. suppress precipitation) is the obvious experiment to test that reported mechanism, and the predicted outcome mirrors the already-observed difference between low-stress and high-stress regions in P1. No new material, regime, or mechanistic link is introduced.
